title: A numeric object id can be read by another account
summary: An object named by a numeric id that belongs to the second account can be read by the first account, so ids can be walked to read other records.  Needs a second account configured for the site.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and status_of(b)==200 and same(response, b) and differ(response, anon)

reproduce: Sign in as account A and open an object URL with account B's numeric id (for example /account/<B's id>).  If A sees B's record, access is broken.
remediate: Check the object's owner against the signed in account on every read.
